Name: Requiring the police department to report on domestic violence arrests and domestic incident reports.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the police department to report on domestic violence arrests and domestic incident reports

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Public Safety

Summary: This bill would require the New York police department to report annually on the total number of domestic violence arrests and the total number of domestic incident reports filed by the department.

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:\ulnone\par
\pard\ltrpar\fi720\qj\par
\pard\ltrpar\fi720\sl480\slmult1\qj Section 1. Paragraph 2 of subdivision e of section 14-150 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by local law number 38 for the year of 2019, is amended to read as follows: \par
2. Beginning June 1, 2019 and annually thereafter, the department shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and shall post on its website, an annual report regarding certain domestic violence initiatives, indicators, and factors in the city. Such report shall include, but need not be limited to the following:\par
(a) The total number of domestic violence complaints, disaggregated by precinct;\par
(b) The total number of chronic domestic violence complaints, disaggregated by borough;\par
(c) The total number of domestic violence offenders, disaggregated by precinct;\par
(d) The total number of chronic offenders, disaggregated by precinct; \par
\ul (e) The total number of domestic violence arrests;\par
(f) The total number of domestic incident reports filed, disaggregated by the victim\rquote s age, gender, ethnicity, race, language spoken, council district, borough, police precinct, and path of encounter with the department, provided that the department shall protect the identities of individuals named in such reports;\par
\ulnone [(e)] \ul (g)\ulnone  The scope of outreach efforts by the department to victims of domestic violence in cases where a perpetrator violates an order of protection issued by a court of competent jurisdiction; and\par
[(f)] \ul (h)\ulnone  Any other interventions by the department that relate to domestic violence.\par
\'a7 2. This local law takes effect immediately. \ul\par
